category.description: High-level usage category supplied by the application.

service.description: Provider product or API, such as EC2 or OpenAI Responses. Do not use a model or resource identifier.

resource.description: Infrastructure resource or AI model identifier.

account_id.description: Direct provider account identifier. Omit when the payload has no account field.

project_id.description: Direct project identifier. Omit when the payload has no project field.

region.description: Cloud region. Omit when the payload has no region field.

usage_type.description: Kind of usage supplied by the application.

input_units.description: Input usage count, such as input or prompt tokens.

output_units.description: Output usage count, such as output or completion tokens.

quantity.description: Generic usage amount. Omit when input_units and output_units describe token usage.

unit.description: Measurement unit supplied by the application when known.

cost.description: Direct monetary cost. Do not derive it from a usage count.

currency.description: Direct currency code. Omit when the payload has no currency field.

usage_start.description: Timestamp when the measured usage began.

usage_end.description: Distinct timestamp when usage ended. Do not copy the start time when no end time exists.
